wifi: ath12k: disable CNSS_QDSS_CFG_MISS_V01 for the WCN7860

This chip requires this change currently to negate a firmware crash. Follows up on the QDSS support in the previous commit.

Signed-off-by: Gianni Spadoni <me@gio.blue>
(cherry picked from commit c5394e3ae9909f7eccae3e5375958c41a2d48b0e)

wifi: ath12k: send QDSS config when CNSS_QDSS_CFG_MISS_V01 is disabled

When CNSS_QDSS_CFG_MISS_V01 is enabled, the WCN7860 crashes when initializing firmware.

At the moment, my best guess is that the AUX_UC is being sent when the firmware has already started initializing.
If CNSS_QDSS_CFG_MISS_V01 is disabled, the chip waits to receive the config before firmware init, giving us enough time to send the AUX_UC.

As it stands, ath12k doesn't support sending the QDSS config - this commit adds support for it.

drm/panel: add OnePlus 15 A0020-family panel driver

DSI command mode with DSC 1.2. The phone ships with one of at least
three panel sources sharing the A0020 DDIC family (AC180, AD296,
AA601), distinguished only at runtime, so the driver identifies the
fitted panel and selects the matching mode and DSC configuration. A
warm DDIC left initialized by the bootloader is powered down over DCS
before the first init so every boot starts from a known state.

patch-config prelude, wait for the controller to drain before the
final ELF segment at init speed, run the peri-subsystem baud
handshake up to the 3.2M operating rate, and re-arm host IBS at the
operating baud.
